fields.statement: QA by hand with the built binary (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a scratch Rhiza root with real wall-clock run IDs, no test clock. Two hold runs started in parallel got IDs 01M6WH7K22GY0EEKR47M709Y4N and 01M6WH7K5Y34JW19BVKB5XTRST, sharing the 8-character prefix the old handle used. With review-01m6wh7k22gy0eekr47m709y4n-r3-f1 pre-taken by an unrelated question, three findings rounds plus a confirmed f1 verdict on each run: review-check on run 1 added review-01m6wh7k22gy0eekr47m709y4n-r3-f1-2 and journalled that handle in its asked entry; on run 2 it added review-01m6wh7k5y34jw19bvkb5xtrst-r3-f1. A repeated review-check on each reported added false and left one asked entry per run; rhiza health showed no duplicate handle. An autonomous run with its full-ID handle pre-taken: rhiza run gate failed before review-check (no question left for f1) and passed after it, finding the -2 question by the journal. Scoped tests (go test ./internal/api -run Review; testscripts run-review-check, -handles, -landed, run-gate, run-arbitrate-asked) pass.
